title: WindowsOnArmGuidanceCorpusV1
description: Manifest for the curated Windows on Arm guidance corpus served through the MCP lookup_windows_arm_guidance tool. Cross-record rules (guidanceId uniqueness, relativePath uniqueness, sha256 verification against the actual snippet files, retrievedAt <= generatedAt) are enforced by the corpus loader/validator, not by JSON Schema. Format assertions (date-time, uri) must be explicitly enabled in the validator.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version tag. Accepts 1.x minor versions.

corpusVersion.description: Human-friendly corpus revision. Convention: 'YYYY-MM-DD.N' where N is the intra-day revision. Every refresh increments this.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when this corpus manifest was produced.

producer.description: What produced this corpus. Recorded in the audit log alongside every planner run.

source.description: Canonical source identifier. Fixed for v1: Microsoft Learn Windows on Arm documentation.

snippets.description: The corpus. Each entry is one addressable guidance chunk with a stable guidanceId.

notes.description: Optional maintainer notes about this corpus revision.

sourceKind.$comment: Distinguishes prototype content from real snapshots so audits show provenance honestly.
sourceKind.description: How the snippets in this corpus were produced.

toolCommit.description: Optional Git commit SHA of the tool that produced the corpus.

Topic.$comment: Closed enum shared with the MCP lookup_windows_arm_guidance tool. Add topics deliberately; do not accept free-text. Must stay in sync with MigrationPlanner.Domain.Guidance.Topic.
Topic.description: Topic tag. Every snippet is tagged with one or more topics; the MCP tool queries by topic.

guidanceId.$comment: Cross-record uniqueness is enforced by the corpus loader, not by JSON Schema.
guidanceId.description: Stable, kebab-case identifier ending in a numeric suffix (e.g. 'arm64ec-overview-01').

sourceUrl.description: Canonical HTTPS URL the snippet was derived from. Restricted to a curated allowlist of trusted Windows-on-Arm / Arm-ecosystem sources: Microsoft Learn, Arm Learning Paths, PyTorch, GitHub docs and blog, ONNX Runtime.

section.description: Section heading (H2 or equivalent) the snippet corresponds to.

retrievedAt.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 UTC timestamp when the source content was retrieved (or, for prototype content, when it was authored).

relativePath.$comment: Uniqueness across snippets is enforced by the corpus loader.
relativePath.description: Path to the snippet markdown file, relative to the corpus root. Must live under 'snippets/' and end in '.md'.

sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the snippet file bytes. Verified by the corpus loader at startup.

topics.description: Topic tags the snippet is relevant to.

summary.description: One-line factual summary the MCP tool returns in list responses.

byteLength.description: Optional recorded byte length of the snippet file; used for extra tamper detection.
